segments.description: Hey coaches, our next presenter is Linton Joseph, the CEO and founder of the Australasian Academy of Tennis Coaches. He is here today to share how he is tackling the shortage of coaches accessible to Australian coaching businesses by explaining his relationship he has created with some overseas countries and how you can access these coaches for your own business. Thanks Linton, over to you. Well welcome everyone, thank you for tuning in. My name is Linton Joseph, I'm from the AATC, the Australasian Academy of Tennis Coaches and we're here to talk about staff shortages and how we can assist local business owners. The AATC is an independent coach education provider, we've been providing quality coach education for the past 14 years and we're working all across Australasia and the United Kingdom and we're also providing job placement opportunities for international coaches to come and work in Australia. We spend a lot of time working overseas and we come across so many coaches, we work both in the cities, the main cities and also rural areas so we make tennis affordable and attainable to people who ordinarily may not have that opportunity and that luxury. We do this by hopefully making dreams come true by finding passionate and hard-working coaches. Our motto is opening the door to tennis but more so we are bringing the world closer by doing that. So staffing is one of the the main issues facing

local business owners here in Australia. As a as a owner of a tennis school myself I've come across staff shortages and and realise the impact this potentially can have on my business so I've availed myself of this particular process of bringing in international coaches doing the whole visa process making sure that they're right for my business and my school. So I don't want to face any more further shortages. I want to have a full proof system that's going to really help my business continue to grow and continue to evolve and and not have to worry about staffing and having staffing shortages. This year alone AATC have placed over 50 coaches throughout Australia and other parts of Southeast Asia. It's a fantastic program, it's working really well, the coaches here are embracing it and we want you if you haven't already taken on someone and you need staff to at least ask the question contact us have a conversation with us we'll make it work for you and the great thing is it's going to cost you zero dollars there's no paperwork for you to do other than an offer letter and we'll do everything else for you and we'll make it happen from other professional letters from health insurance from police checks completing the application and putting all all the money and into it and the good thing is you don't need to be affiliated with AATC you don't have to be an AATC coach if you're a tennis Australia coach great we're happy to help your business if you're in

any other other denomination we're happy to help as well all we want is our international coaches be given this opportunity to come and work in Australia think about it think about the life changing experience that you're going to give a particular coach who would never ever dream of being able to come and work in in our in our fantastic country think of the lives that you're changing think about the the cultures that you're bringing together and for a new hybrid model in your own business these are some things that that I suppose money can't buy but life journey life experiences can give you give you that opportunity so how does AATC proposed to solve the staff shortage issue well as mentioned earlier we have several several coaches ready and willing to travel to Australia and help you in your business and work work for you gone are the days where you would get a random email spam if you like saying dear sir madam I'd love to work in your esteemed academy and they'd attach a resume which invariably I would never look at the amount that come across my desk unfortunately straight to junk straight to trash our system is is put we put a lot of work hard work into our system by vetting our coaches they provide a video not just one not just two but several the first videos is them speaking so you get to see the tone of their voice the language barrier what they talk about you get to learn a bit about them

what their tennis journey is what their personal interests are and you can make a judgment call on that if you like the secondary video is of them actually playing tennis so instead of saying I've done this tournament I've done this I've done that you can actually see them demonstrate are they hitting a forehand backhand the volleys of serve you can see their actual technique and their level of play and then you can also from there decipher how they're going to go when they demonstrate the stroke during the lesson additional videos include group lessons so you can see how their voice projection is how they're managing a class how idle other students are within that class what are they doing are they paying attention or are they idle for too long we know lesson management's a lot easier than error detection and correction but the group lesson will actually be able to decipher are they providing correction to the the actual lesson to the actual student they're important things error detection and correction the private lessons we'll also be looking at was that lesson suitable for that particular customer in your eyes we'll try our best to vet that as as properly as we can all of the above are short videos that are going to help you you make a decision I like to be able to see how the coach is so I can make a judgment call we need to see them be able to to see whether or not they're right it's not practical for us to fly someone to

Australia for an interview so this is the next the next best thing and we'll provide you with short videos attached to a particular coach and you will say yes or no that's that's the actual coach I want and then we'll facilitate the next phase of the program which is the the interview the interview part but you know you'll see the videos you'll get to work out whether or not that person is is the right one for your business and and we'll take it take it from there the three fundamentals of AATCR as a coach are making a fun and engaging lesson are they hitting enough tennis balls during that lesson and thirdly and most importantly they've got to take away two or three learning points and so these are some of the things that we'll be making sure that our coaches are learning during our courses as a priority and and and and and then we try and translate that to the video so that you can actually look at the video and and have all the boxes ticked so that you can say yep I can work with that person yeah they might need a little bit more work but yep they're the type of person I would like to have in in our in our business and and that's pretty much where where it all where it all grows and where the experience starts what happens when you when you choose a coach well we we straight away tell the the coach the good news that someone's interested in their services and we facilitate a three-way meeting

online meeting where we get yourself the international coach and and a member of AATC and if it's your first time dealing with AATC it'll be with myself and we'll go through an interview process where you can ask more questions beyond what you've seen in the video so you can get a a whole package in terms of is this the right person that's going to assist with what you actually need and you usually know during that interview stage whether or not this is going to work for you or not and and if it doesn't well go back to drawing board look at other coaches but but hopefully you've made the right choice with the videos because it from my experience that's pretty much where where it all starts to to move forward and move forward really quickly so that you can get your your your shortage problem solved so so what happens with the with the visa process rest assured we cover everything for you if you were to do it use of immigration lawyer here in Australia have the process done you're looking at upwards of 2500 plus this will cost you zero dollars if you're taking on an AATC international coach we'll cover that whole cost for you we'll use our lawyers and will you will complete the application process through home affairs all we ask is that you're able to offer this coach that you choose one term of coaching give them that opportunity for one term and and and if it works out you have the power and the ability to extend

as well as as if it doesn't work out immediately as then we have contingency plans in place that allows that coach to have some sort of experience here we will help you prepare a contract that's fair for yourself and for the coach we're happy to look over it we encourage you to have your your are your legals look over them as well if you require but they're usually stock stock standard we'll also assist you with a offer letter that we will need as part of the process and that offer letter will go a long way to helping them with their visa we'll do everything else at AATC headquarters and this this includes ensuring the coach's overseas health insurance is up to date their their police check or their PCC from the overseas country is is intact we'll apply and pay for the visa and and we'll attain all the professional letters necessary which includes letters from AATC, Tennis Australia and and anything else that's going to help them with their with their application for coaches that are already in Australia that need their visas extended we can also help with that process too and but that's a whole different process that we will look at so yeah I mean send that you don't have to worry about anything else we're going to streamline this process make it easy for you make your experience a positive one with AATC and with the international coach and and this can take anywhere between four to five

days to 28 days to find out whether or not the visa has been approved touch wood we've had 100 percent of visas approved we're very confident that this will will work will work for you and we want to see it work and Tennis Australia want to see it work and you know only as I said at the start it'll only help your business grow and and tennis grow in our country so some of the reasons why why Australian local business owners take on coaches and and several reasons obviously staff shortage but it's critical shortage of quality quality coaches and those actually willing to work work here they cater for ethical and cultural diversity by bringing an international coach a coach over we're lacking experienced coaches especially since since COVID since the COVID years we get a difference perspective we're bringing in on on different coaching styles the way people do things in different countries to here and we've got the Australian way of teaching we've got the European way we've got the Southeast Asian way we've got the South American way there's so many different ways but bringing the blend together quite often is is always a positive positive result my experience and experience of coaches that I've worked with is international coaches provide a lot more stability and loyalty and a strong work ethic they want to work they need to work they take on feedback which is of paramount importance when

when delivering and improving your own your own team regional remote locations are a wonderful opportunity as well personally it's a it's a lot easier working in in the regions a lot more peaceful than in the city environment but at the same time the city has its pluses as well we the reason other reason coaches are using us is as mentioned before is we're taking the headache away from this visa process for you the business owner we want to make it easier and maintain that we are invested in not only coach education but in job placement so we want this to be successful we want our overseas coaches coming here we want to make their dreams come true and we're really really passionate about that and the coaches that have so far taken on staff have the same mindset they know that they are making a great opportunity for someone who would never ever dream of having this happen to them in their lives and bear in mind that these coaches are taking huge huge risks they're leaving quite often young families to to come and work for a better a better future for themselves and these are things that you've got to got to consider we'll always provide ongoing support we regularly meet with our coaches that are here we have zoom meetings once a month just touch it touch base how are you how you're going what's happening we use the current coaches with new coaches coming to be a mentor of sorts so that they understand some of the pitfalls they've experienced when we train the

coaches in in in our overseas trips we we are very real we talk about the cost of airfares the cost of living here utilities sim cards my key cards transport food what everything's going to cost them and that's very real so they come here with their eyes wide open there's no shock there's no shock factor putting in touch with communities medical services all those kind of things we'll cover that again a little bit later but they need to know every single thing that that's going on and and and we've we've got a couple of coaches here who've sent in some videos just to let let us know or let you know what experiences they've had and how they felt we've got Paul Osborne from Aussie's tennis coaching here in Beaconsfield in Melbourne as well as Jaren Kretschman from Milparra Connection Limited and remote tennis services out in the outback of WA and they've been great supporters of what this program and what we're doing and they've been so supportive and encouraging for the staff that they've come across constant contact with AATC and we're in constant contact with them as well as their staff that are here because these are the kind of coaches that are ensuring this program is is working and and you know if you don't want to hear it from us you can be in touch with with them and they'll be happily happily able to to share their experience with them so yeah have a listen to Paul and Jaren and and and hear where what what they have to say

Hi my name is Jaren Kretschman I'm from Remote Tennis Services Australia just want to tell you a little bit about our relationship with AATC and it is and what it is that we do we specialize in regional remote area servicing across approximately two-thirds of Western Australia and over half of Northern Territory and in particular our Indigenous Tennis and Learning program in partnership with Milparra the nation's leading Indigenous Engagement program the relationship that we have with AATC has been second to none the swift and fast prompt service from Linton and his team both here and in India has allowed us to continue delivering our highly sustainable and professional services across this vast region through the delivery and services provided by the AATC coaches out of India who are highly qualified, highly knowledgeable and dedicated to what they do I strongly recommend if you're in need of coaches to get in touch with Linton and his team the service is second to none and with the critical shortage of coaches in Australia it's what we need to keep this industry going. Cheers! Hi everyone it's Paul Osborne here from Oslo's Tennis Coaching at the Fantastic Peekle Steel Tennis Club I also have another club out at Warrigal where we run coaching programs all sorts for all people and different standards different ages adult lessons children's lessons all sorts of things. Over the last few years we've grown exponentially with coaching numbers

and as such now you need to source more tennis coaches to join our team we currently have a team of 14 coaches bearing from VCE students who might be nearest trainee coaches to some senior coaches taking adult lessons private lessons cardio tennis all our programs. It's been a big problem in the industry of recent years with sourcing ballicky tennis coaches especially senior coaches for club level I was lucky enough to come across AATC and with the help of Linton Joseph the CEO of the Australasian Academy of Tennis Coaches I was able to source Rajar Bota who's coaching over here behind me he comes from India he came out three months ago and he's done a three month trial within our business and has exceeded all expectations Rajar has been absolutely brilliant with our clientele working together with a team of coaches he's enthusiastic he's hardworking he knows his stuff and he's always willing to learn and bring more to the table for our business here at Beaconsfield. I would suggest anyone out there considering this opportunity of working with AATC and bringing out some coaches from India I think I've got one of the lucky ones or I've been one of the lucky ones to have attracted Rajar he ticks all the boxes for me and I'll certainly be looking at something similar in the future so if you've got any questions shoot me a message get hold of Linton through AATC and I'm sure he will be happy to help you out with

any of your staffing needs for any business owners out there looking for more quality tennis coaches thanks very much Merry Christmas everyone hi I'm Kavya Monika Nandimidhala from India in this video I would like to share my working experience with the Australasian Academy of Tennis Coaches here in Melbourne Australia first and foremost I sincerely appreciate and thank Mr. Linton Joseph Sir for helping me in adjusting to this new place and also making sure that I'm having a safe here in Melbourne it has been over two months since I started coaching in Melbourne I'm gaining experience coaching different levels from Red Bull stage to group lessons, private classes and social cardio from which I'm learning a lot of different approaches towards the coaching I'm not only getting to coach but I'm also getting to participate in new training programs from where I'm learning a lot of valuable practical skills I would also like to thank Mr. Michael Robertson Sir who is a former tennis player a senior tennis coach and also an associate with AATC for mentoring me and sharing his immense knowledge with me thank you AATC for making me a part of your AATC family thank you AATC thank you so what happens when the the visa is approved well the great news is passed on to both yourself and to the the international coach and then that's when the real work starts that's when we provide our concierge service

and what that involves is preparing both parties mainly the international coach for travel to Australia if they're arriving in Melbourne I personally or someone from AATC will will go and greet them at the airport and we would hope that someone from the from your your business would also be there to meet them as well welcome them and take them to where they're going we'll ensure the airfares are booked and that accommodation is sourced and and and and try and make sure it's local to where they're going to be working public transport in most of the areas are great and and and we have staff who do travel more than one train to get to their venues but always punctual always early they understand the importance of being there and understanding that on time is late being there 30 minutes at least to an hour before they actually start we review the contract again to make sure that everyone's happy and understands clearly what it means for both the business owner and the coach so the expectations are shared we ensure and make sure that the coach brings sort of suitable identification with photo ID so that they can apply for a bank account we explain to them about the tax file number requirements what their tax requirements are in this country superannuation making sure that these these items are ready to go so they can actually get paid budgeting understanding which SIM cards to start considering

what all these costs are health insurance emergency numbers contact details putting in touch with people in their own community from some different facebook groups is really really important making sure they bring a laptop because when you're when you're completing your your time sheets your pay sheets doing on your phones not not going to cut it having a laptop something simple like that is really important to consider what to declare at customs as well quite often the coach is really excited and they want to bring gifts for yourself the gifts they bring and always write you know on a long flight when you're completing the declaration card you just tick in the box to get in and out but it's actually quite a serious form that you have to take serious and and we take the the rules and legislation surrounding home affairs and and and and and the visits it's really important the last thing you want is them stuck in customs by bringing the wrong the wrong item so declare everything that's a simple rule just declare everything putting in touch with local community so introducing them to your customers before they're here you know so-and-so is coming from this particular country and this is what they're going to bring to our our community and then from there you might get conversations starting yes yes i'd love to be able to house this person i've got a room or i'd like to show them into our

community bring them in in that kind of thing these things are all great we also know that it's going to be a honeymoon period that they're going to experience they're going to have experience that high but then they're going to experience a severe low and and and we'll be counselling them through that process to see how they're going we'll be talking with yourself to make sure that they are you know doing okay you know are you okay is never more more prominent than it is in this particular case because all of a sudden they've changed life big time the cultural experience change or the swing in that is huge they're missing family they're not going to see family for at least at least three months and then if you extend them that might even be longer because the cost of airfares as you know has gone up and and that's quite expensive so all these things are things to consider about we encourage you again like mentioned earlier is meet them and meet and greet them at the airport welcome them that's that's a fantastic thing to do involving them in activities of your team making them a part of the team uniforms you might not have uniforms ready for them but they'll have a ATC apparel that they can wear and they look like a tennis coach anyway within your business until you've such time as you can gear them up and there's anything else we haven't covered we were always open to developing this program it is a work in progress it's always

going to be a work in progress things are going to constantly change and we're going to be learning about different pitfalls different ways that we can make this a lot better for all parties including including the coach yourself as well as a ATC but like like I've said all along is this we want this to work tennis Australia want this to work local business owners want this to work and if you're not sure yet give us get on the phone give us a call and I'm happily have a chat with you for as long as it takes just to to walk you through this meet some of the coaches that are actually here from overseas countries and see where they're going so we've got coaches from South America the United Kingdom India Singapore China but there's some really good stories out there and and when you you see the happiness in in faces that you come across of people's lives that have been changed you realize what what you're doing here and you know opening the door to tennis just bringing the world closer is really really important okay so just just to close I'd like to thank you all for for tuning in to our to our session on staff shortages and the barriers and how we can minimize that so this is and it's a process that just hasn't happened overnight it's something we thought long and hard about I myself am born overseas and and if my folks hadn't given me the opportunity and migrated when I was one I would not be able to be to be here to

be able to provide the same opportunity for overseas coaches I look at the sacrifices my folks made back in the early 70s and and what they would have done and I also hear the stories of the sacrifices that they made just to come here leaving family leaving a way of life come here with with no more than ten dollars in your pocket and and then survive and provide opportunity that's the best country in the world I think and and so so would yourselves but it's a great opportunity to to bring people across you to experience that as a very very minimum understand it's a real life-changing experience that you're you're doing for someone and that's the real crux of it it's not about the money it's not about anything else it's really about that life-changing experience and what you're doing and and it'll make you feel feel a certain way and when you feel that certain way you understand you'll you'll get it we feel so much pride and humility in in in how this has changed people's lives and and that's what we want to get across it's it's it's humbling to be a part of such a journey of an international coach and being being part of the solution for for staff staff shortages for local business owners and hopefully we've covered everything and if we haven't please please reach out from but I'd also like to just thank everyone at AATC our team overseas that that that do a lot of work to make this happen

the coaches that have have trusted us with international coaches the international coaches who put their trust in us to place them with a coach like your business owners like like yourselves who are willing to take someone on and work with them knowing that they are quite raw around the years or wet around the years that we do encourage you to spend a week or two helping them assimilate and fit into your way of doing things like I said they take on feedback they are willing to learn and always wanting to learn they they just learn yearn to learn and and that's a really attractive thing the team at AATC AATC and myself would like to thank Scott Rawlins and Adam Carey from Tennis Australia for giving us this opportunity to be able to present present what we're what we're actually doing here at the Tennis Australia Virtual Grand Slam Coaches Conference it's a huge thrill and we're ever ever grateful for the for the opportunity we hope we've provided enough opportunity information for you and we hope that you're able to take that next step and take a risk and and contact us and see what we can we can do for you like I said it costs you nothing and that it's a great it's a great fee for the for the wonderful experience that you will have and 2024 can be solved whether it's term one term two term three term four or you can just plan for 2025 it doesn't matter we can have coaches come here for short-term experiences coaches here want to stay

for longer these are all the great things and you know if you have any problems with coaches whilst they're here we'll step in and we'll help and we'll be part of that mediation process but but again I'm Linton Joseph I really appreciate you tuning in and I hope you have a wonderful year on and off the court and stay safe and stay healthy thank you
